intro: Light's Justice is a Forsaken quest issued by Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity. Tasked with purging the lingering Scourge from the Ruins of Lordaeron above, adventurers gather intact limbs needed to repair and sustain their decaying Forsaken brethren.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.
Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.
Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!
With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
